mapper.select: select wr.dates, wr.id source_id, wr.project_name, wr.user_id, wr.withdraw_type, wr.status, wr.amount, IFNULL(wr.fee, 0) fee, #{singleFee} `exchange_rate`, ROUND(wr.amount / #{singleFee}, 8) `change_amount`, ROUND((IFNULL(wr.fee, 0)) / #{singleFee}, 8) `change_fee`, ROUND((IFNULL(wr.fee, 0) + wr.amount) / #{singleFee}, 8) change_total_amount, wr.num, uv.max_pvn version, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, uv.pvn register_version, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, wr.created) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, wr.dates) register_day, wr.created create_time from ods_withdraw_record wr INNER JOIN ods_user u on (wr.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, MIN(uv.pvn) pvn, max(uv.pvn) max_pvn FROM ods_user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv on (uv.user_id = u.id) where wr.dates = #{dates} limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}
